description: This PHP source file defines the XmlRpcUtils class, providing static methods for handling XML-RPC responses, encoding data types, converting data structures, and processing XML-RPC parameters and fields within the Revive Adserver project.

classes.name: XmlRpcUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for handling XML-RPC responses, encoding/decoding data types, converting data structures, and processing XML-RPC parameters within the Revive Adserver project.

methods.name: generateError
methods.description: Generates an XML-RPC error response with a custom message.

methods.name: stringTypeResponse
methods.description: Creates an XML-RPC response containing a string value.

methods.name: booleanTypeResponse
methods.description: Creates an XML-RPC response containing a boolean value.

methods.name: integerTypeResponse
methods.description: Creates an XML-RPC response containing an integer value.

methods.name: arrayOfStructuresResponse
methods.description: Converts an array or recordset into an XML-RPC response with an array of structures.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Converts an info object into an XML-RPC struct value.

methods.name: getEntityWithNotNullFields
methods.description: Converts an info object into an XML-RPC struct, excluding null fields.

methods.name: getEntityResponse
methods.description: Wraps an info object into an XML-RPC response.

methods.name: getArrayOfEntityResponse
methods.description: Creates an XML-RPC response containing an array of entity responses.

methods.name: _setRPCTypeWithDefaultValues
methods.description: Encodes a variable into an XML-RPC value with default handling for nulls based on type.

methods.name: _setRPCTypeForField
methods.description: Encodes a variable into an XML-RPC value based on specified field type.

methods.name: _convertDateFromIso8601Format
methods.description: Converts an ISO 8601 date string into a PEAR::Date object, with validation.

methods.name: _getScalarValue
methods.description: Extracts a scalar value from an XML_RPC_Value, handling different types.

methods.name: getNonScalarValue
methods.description: Decodes a non-scalar XML_RPC_Value into a PHP variable.

methods.name: getNotRequiredNonScalarValue
methods.description: Retrieves a non-scalar value from parameters if present, otherwise null.

methods.name: getRequiredScalarValue
methods.description: Retrieves a required scalar value from parameters.

methods.name: _getStructureScalarField
methods.description: Extracts a scalar field from an XML-RPC struct parameter.

methods.name: _getStructureNonScalarField
methods.description: Extracts a non-scalar field from an XML-RPC struct parameter.

methods.name: getStructureScalarFields
methods.description: Retrieves multiple scalar fields from an XML-RPC struct parameter.

methods.name: getArrayOfStructuresScalarFields
methods.description: Retrieves an array of structures with specified scalar fields from parameters.

methods.name: getStructureScalarAndNotScalarFields
methods.description: Retrieves both scalar and non-scalar fields from an XML-RPC struct.
